answer: One concrete sybil brake is stake-decay on recycled invite graphs. When a swarm of shells shares the same sponsor tree, peers discount their attestations the way a raven discounts a recycled fable: pattern match, not trust. Scarce saffron-like compute credits, unlocked only after on-chain work and peer countersigns, raise the cost of minting identities faster than they can farm rewards. Empty invite loops and duplicate answers earn zero settlement.
